question: Which country hosted the World Championships in Athletics (18th) in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**United States of America.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Championships in Athletics (18th):-**

 
 
• The World Athletics Championships are a global track and field event that is held every two years.
 
• The World Athletics Championships are one of the most prestigious sporting events in the world.
 
• The championships attract the best athletes from over 200 countries. The championships are also a major television event, with millions of people watching the competitions around the world.
 
• The championships were first held in 1983, and they have been held in a different city each time. 
 
• The **18th edition** of the **World Championships** in** Athletics** was scheduled to be held in **Eugene, Oregon, USA,** from **July 15 to 24, 2022.**
 
• However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was rescheduled to **July 15-24, 2022**, and will now be held i**n Hayward Field, Eugene, Oregon, USA.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Japan** has hosted the event twice before, in** Tokyo in 1991 and Osaka in 2007.**
 
• **Qatar **has hosted the **World Championships** in Athletics once before, in **Doha in 2019.**
 
• **Colombia **has never hosted the **World Championships in Athletics.**
